arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Cohen argued that the district court found the standard fee insufficient for the quality of work.
Mr. Shah argued that a bonus is only justified if the standard fee is unreasonably low.
Justice Ginsburg noted that the lower court judge praised the lawyers' amazing performance.
Justice Scalia questioned whether the fee increase truly reflected the quality of representation.
